payload.title: Navigating the perils of a model grid
payload.summary: This notebook explores the challenges of working with model grids in climate data analysis. It highlights the differences between intuitive latitude-longitude coordinates and the reality of model grids. The notebook demonstrates how to handle and visualize data on these grids using various plotting techniques. It also provides examples of working with datasets from CMIP6 and C-iTRACE experiments, focusing on extracting and visualizing specific variables.
